definition: חִין noun [masculine] חִין עֶרְכּוֺ Job 41:4 the grace of his proportions ( = חֵן Aramaic חִנָּא ) so AV RV Thes De Volck Da and others; meaning not very appropriate in context (description of crocodile); but nothing better has been proposed; see suggestions in Di .
